description: crl.rs lines 279-316: in check_revocation, when a delta CRL is present the DER bytes are parsed into a CertificateList twice. First at line 281 to extract and cross-check the issuer name, then a second time inside verify_delta_crl_and_collect at line 488. This is O(2) parsing per check_revocation call with a delta, and allocates the CertificateList structure twice. The redundant parse happens because the name-check block (lines 279-293) was written as a separate 'defense-in-depth' guard before calling the helper, but the helper immediately re-parses the same bytes. Suggested fix: refactor verify_delta_crl_and_collect to accept an already-parsed CertificateList (or add a separate parse-only helper), so the outer block can perform its name-check on the already-parsed structure and pass it to the helper rather than triggering a second parse.
title: P2: Delta CRL parsed twice in check_revocation (redundant allocation)
